# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated, read-only directory of 5,716 AI agent tools in 40 categories, including 3,177 MCP servers. Checked daily, 3169 of 3177 checked servers live, last checked 2026-11-11. Listings are link-checked daily; pricing is as makers state it. Featured slots are clearly labeled and sit above the list; rankings are never paid. This file tells AI agents and assistants how to use the directory.

<!-- mcp-reach:start -->

## MCP server reachability

Checked daily, 3169 of 3177 checked servers live, last checked 2026-11-11.

Once a day, AgentScout requests every MCP server in the directory, including catalog-only listings, and, when it is a different link, its GitHub URL. The request is HEAD, then GET, with a 20-second timeout. If that fails on TLS or gets no response, it retries once with a browser user agent. A server counts as live when its stored label is OK or Reachable, blocks automated checks. OK is HTTP 200-399 or 405, and also 401, 403 or 429 when the GitHub URL succeeded or that URL is the only one checked. Reachable, blocks automated checks means those 401, 403 or 429 responses without a harder error. Any other checked result is not live. The live percentage uses only servers with a row in the check file: live plus down. A server with no row is listed, not yet checked, and is not part of that percentage. Catalog-only listings stay unverified until that daily check opens them. The last-checked time is the checked field, in America/Los_Angeles. The rows are on the MCP status page and in status.json.

- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): the same reachability rows, with HTTP result and history
- [status.json](https://agentscouthq.com/status.json): machine-readable rows for every listed MCP server
- [Best MCP servers by task](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/): ranked lists, with the same daily check

<!-- mcp-reach:end -->

Entity note: AgentScout (also searched as Agent Scout or AgentScoutHQ) is the independent AI agent and MCP server directory at https://agentscouthq.com, published in the official MCP Registry as com.agentscouthq/directory with endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp. AgentScout's official MCP server (com.agentscouthq/directory at https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp) is 100% free, public, and read-only, with no API key, crypto wallet, or x402 payment required. It is completely unrelated to the paid third-party x402 web-fetch package that shares a similar name.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ, https://x.com/clampdown19
MCP Registry ID: com.agentscouthq/directory
MCP Endpoint: https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp — 100% free, read-only, no API key or x402 wallet required)
Catalog last checked: 2026-11-11 (Pacific)

## For AI agents

- Fastest path: fetch [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json) once and filter it locally. No key, no rate-limited API, plain HTTPS GET.
- api/tools.json is an object with `count`, `last_checked` (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific) and `tools`, an array where each tool has `name`, `slug`, `category`, `description`, `url`, `website`, `github`, `pricing` (maker's wording), `price_tag` (free / freemium / paid), `platforms`, `open_source`, `license`, `github_stars`, `tags`, `added` and `page` (its AgentScout listing).
- To cite a tool, link its `page` (https://agentscouthq.com/tools/<slug>.html). To cite a category, use the category links below.
- Treat `pricing` as the maker's own claim on the date shown; it can change. GitHub stars are refreshed daily.
- Everything here is read-only. There is no chat, search or write endpoint for agents; to list a tool, a person uses the submit form.

## Update cadence

- New tools: added most days; see the Recently added section below and new.html.
- Links: checked daily (`last_checked` in api/tools.json).
- MCP pricing and link-status tables: rebuilt with every site update, each with a dated change history.
- GitHub stars: snapshot daily.
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml) carries a per-page lastmod.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [llms-full.txt](https://agentscouthq.com/llms-full.txt): single-file Markdown context with category comparison tables and all 3,177 verified MCP servers (pricing, link status, runs_locally, license, stars, endpoints)
- [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json): full catalog with counts and check date
- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): same tools in the site's internal format
- [api/products.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/products.json): Stripe Agentic Commerce product feed for maker listing packages (free, $15 fast-track, or a homepage and newsletter sponsorship) and Made by AgentScout pre-trained bots (also at [.well-known/acp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/acp.json))
- [.well-known/ai-plugin.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): AI plugin manifest with prompt-engineered model instructions
- [openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.json) & [openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 JSON & YAML descriptions of the feeds under /api/ (also at [.well-known/openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.json) and [.well-known/openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml))
- [manifest.json](https://agentscouthq.com/manifest.json): Web app brand manifest with icons and theme colors
- [.well-known/mcp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/mcp.json): MCP server card pointing to https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent card describing this directory (also at /.well-known/agent.json)
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages
- [feed.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 of the latest tools and agent news

- [AgentScout MCP server](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/connect.html): free, read-only MCP endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no key; also at https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp) with search_tools, get_tool, list_categories, best_for_task and list_packages. Optional runs_locally filter: offline, self_hosted_or_offline or any; locality is inferred from listings, so verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- Tools added in the last 2 days (2026-11-10 to 2026-11-11): 3308

- [Modulify](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/modulify.html) (added 2026-11-11): Modulify turns a text prompt into a working website or web app, such as a landing page, marketing site, dashboard, internal tool or clickable prototype, with layouts, copy, images, a CMS, a database, analytics and hosting included, and you can edit anything visually before publishing; it targets founders, marketers, designers, product managers and ops teams, has free templates and paid plans.
- [RLinf](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/rlinf.html) (added 2026-11-11): RLinf is an Apache-2.0 reinforcement-learning infrastructure for embodied and agentic AI that scales PPO and GRPO training across GPUs for vision-language-action robot policies and LLM agents, with recent support for OpenPI pi0.5 fine-tuning, GenieSim, SO-101 arms and humanoid simulators; documentation is on Read the Docs.
- [Agency Orchestrator](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agency-orchestrator.html) (added 2026-11-11): Agency Orchestrator is an Apache-2.0 multi-agent tool that turns one sentence into a team of AI expert roles, 276 in Chinese and 184 in English, which collaborate through zero-code YAML workflows and deliver a finished plan checked against acceptance criteria, pausing for your sign-off on big decisions; it runs as a local web studio, desktop app or Docker image with about 20 model providers, including ones that reuse a signed-in Claude Code or Gemini CLI.
- [Magic Context](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/magic-context.html) (added 2026-11-11): Magic Context is an MIT-licensed memory layer for coding agents, part of CortexKit, that keeps one long-running session per project: it captures what happens, consolidates it into durable memory and recalls the relevant context later, so the agent remembers past decisions instead of starting each task from scratch; it includes a dashboard and configuration docs.
- [Paperasse](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/paperasse.html) (added 2026-11-11): Paperasse is an MIT-licensed collection of Agent Skills, in French, that turn Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor and other agents into copilots for French business paperwork: bookkeeping and VAT, year-end closing and tax returns, 2026 e-invoicing rules, tax audits, personal income tax and wealth tax, notarial law for property and inheritance, and condominium management, with references to the French tax and civil codes.
- [Aaron Marketing Skills](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/aaron-marketing-skills.html) (added 2026-11-11): Aaron Marketing Skills is an Apache-2.0 pack of 120 marketing Agent Skills across seven disciplines, narrative, SEO and GEO, social, email, paid ads, influencer and launch, installable as one plugin, as portable skills on many agent hosts or as an eight-bot team, with auditor gates that score content quality and campaign readiness; skills are plain Markdown with small Bash and Python runtimes.
- [Finance Skills](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/finance-skills.html) (added 2026-11-11): Finance Skills is an MIT-licensed collection of Agent Skills for financial analysis and trading research, installable as Codex plugin groups or with npx skills for other agents, and grouped into market analysis and data-provider packs, some with bundled MCP servers; documentation and demos are at skills.himself65.com, and the README stresses it is for education, not financial advice.
- [HiThink Finance (Tonghuashun Financial Data)](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/hithink-finance-tonghuashun-financial-data.html) (added 2026-11-11): HiThink Finance is the official Tonghuashun (10jqka) financial data service for China's A-share market, aimed at AI agents and quant research: one API key gives real-time and historical quotes, call auctions, financial statements, valuations, indices, sectors, funds and IPO data through a REST API, a hosted MCP server, a CLI with built-in agent skills, a Python SDK or a local DuckDB store. The client code is MIT-licensed; the data needs an API key.
- [Desktop CC GUI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/desktop-cc-gui.html) (added 2026-11-11): Desktop CC GUI (ccgui) is an MIT-licensed desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that puts command-line coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex CLI, Kimi CLI, Grok CLI, OpenCode, Qoder and DeepSeek Harness, behind one graphical interface, with streaming output, visible thinking and tool calls, token usage and Git commits; it is built with Tauri, React and Rust and keeps settings locally.
- [RikkaHub](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/rikkahub.html) (added 2026-11-11): RikkaHub is an AGPL-3.0 native Android chat client for large language models that lets you switch between many providers and models in one app, with conversations stored on the device; it is available from its website and Google Play, and its README warns users to avoid unofficial forks.
- [SkillOpt](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/skillopt.html) (added 2026-11-11): SkillOpt is Microsoft's MIT-licensed optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents without touching model weights: it runs epochs and mini-batches over agent trajectories, proposes text edits, keeps only changes that pass validation gates and exports a deployable best_skill.md. It is on PyPI, and the paper is a NeurIPS 2026 spotlight.
- [Scientific Agent Skills](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/scientific-agent-skills.html) (added 2026-11-11): Scientific Agent Skills, formerly Claude Scientific Skills, is K-Dense's MIT-licensed library of 177 validated Agent Skills plus connectors to more than 100 scientific databases for biology, chemistry, medicine and drug discovery; it works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and any agent that supports the open Agent Skills standard, and also powers K-Dense BYOK, a free desktop co-scientist that runs on your own API keys.
- [Daily Stock Analysis](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/daily-stock-analysis.html) (added 2026-11-11): Daily Stock Analysis is an MIT-licensed, LLM-driven system that analyses a personal watchlist across A-shares, Hong Kong, US, Japanese, Korean and Taiwanese stocks and ETFs, pulling quotes, technical indicators, news and filings, then pushes a daily decision dashboard with scores, levels, risk alerts and a checklist to WeCom, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, Slack or email. It runs free on GitHub Actions, Docker or locally, has a web and desktop workbench with backtests, and an agent mode for follow-up questions using 15 built-in strategies. It is not financial advice.
- [lfm](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/lfm.html) (added 2026-11-11): lfm is a free, MIT-licensed Go CLI and set of agent skills that turns a coding agent into a landing-page builder: the agent first researches where real buyers talk and what they ask, then lfm compiles one static landing page with your payment link and runs built-in copy, SEO, accessibility and Lighthouse checks before you publish. No account is needed.
- [SML URL to Markdown API](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/sml-url-to-markdown-api.html) (added 2026-11-11): ScriptMasterLabs' URL to Markdown API turns any public HTTPS page into clean, LLM-ready Markdown for AI agents and RAG pipelines; there is no account or API key, each accepted read costs 0.001 USDC on Base via the x402 protocol, failed reads are free, and a $2 card pack of 200 reads covers developers without a wallet.
- [SqueezeOS](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/squeezeos.html) (added 2026-11-11): SqueezeOS is ScriptMasterLabs' live MCP gateway that lets an AI agent discover and call pay-per-call agent APIs, such as URL-to-Markdown reads, paid in USDC on Base over the x402 protocol, with no account or API key; the tool list is dynamic, and the agent pays only for accepted calls.

## Launches, status, and the Directory Launch Pack

- [How AgentScout started](https://agentscouthq.com/how-it-started.html): founder-run, mostly automated with AI agents. @clampdown19 (m lk) makes the calls.
- [Weekly launch board](https://agentscouthq.com/launches/): tools added each ISO week (Pacific), with server-side upvotes.
- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): up, down, and not-yet-checked counts. Updated daily, around 7 AM PT.
- [Directory Launch Pack](https://agentscouthq.com/submit.html#launch-pack): $49 one-time add-on, separate from the four listing tiers ($0 / $15 / $49 / $99/wk). Submitted to ~25 curated AI directories within 7 days, with a report of live and pending links, plus a follow-up report at 30 days (some directories take weeks to approve). Listings use your own email so you own every account. A few directories (e.g. ones that use GitHub or Google sign-in) may need you to click a quick sign-in yourself. If your tool is already listed in one of those directories, we skip it and submit to another from the same curated list. This is a separate add-on, not one of the four listing tiers ($0 / $15 / $49 / $99/wk). It does not change your rank on AgentScout and does not include Google indexing. Checkout: https://buy.stripe.com/28EfZidhp6lp9l3aDFe7m0f Refunds: https://agentscouthq.com/refunds.html
- Fast-Track ($15) includes: Same-day indexing ping to Bing and IndexNow search engines (does not include Google).
